name: lever neck left side flexion (plate loaded)
description: A plate-loaded neck exercise that bends the head sideways to the left to strengthen the side neck muscles.
instructions: Set the weight light and position the pad against the left side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the left against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.
